name: Helping Hand for Relief and Development
mission: Helping Hand for Relief and Development is a global humanitarian relief and development organization responding to human sufferings in emergency and disastrous situations anywhere all over the world regardless race, gender, ethnicity, class, location, religion, color, cultural diversity and social background; with special focus on countries where the massive population is living below the poverty line. In addition to our emergency relief efforts in natural or man made disaster areas, we also work on long term relief and development programs like livelihood, economic empowerment, orphan and widows support program and skill development program.
theoryOfChange: HHRD recognizes education as a basic human right and one of the most direct and viable pathways out of poverty. We believe that graduating from a four-year degree program after intermediate is the most effective means for our students to earn higher lifetime incomes, have better health outcomes, and enjoy fulfilling lives.

rich_narrative.summary: Helping Hand for Relief and Development (HHRD) is a global humanitarian organization that provides emergency disaster relief and long-term developmental aid. The organization maintains a <cite id="1">perfect 100/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting exceptional standards of accountability and transparency. In FY2023, the charity reported <cite id="3">$94,048,415 in total revenue</cite>, though it saw a <cite id="3">revenue decline to $89,337,007 in FY2024</cite>. Despite this recent dip, HHRD remains a highly efficient operator, directing <cite id="1">90.2% of its total expenses toward program services</cite>. The charity is <cite id="2">fully zakat-eligible</cite> and serves eight major categories of zakat recipients, including the poor and needy. Its work spans over <cite id="4">10 countries</cite>, including Pakistan, Jordan, and Palestine. Key initiatives include <cite id="10">re-registering 315 out-of-school children</cite> and awarding <cite id="9">11,667 higher education scholarships</cite>. HHRD also provides specialized care for vulnerable groups, such as <cite id="16">distributing wheelchairs and providing physical therapy</cite> through its Comprehensive Physical Rehabilitation Program.
